purpose: candidates evaluated and not shortlisted, with the evidence that eliminated each. No accounts created anywhere.

candidates.name: Stats Perform / Opta
candidates.evidence: "3,900+ competitions and 20+ sports", "7.2+ PB of proprietary sports data", xG and "XY tracking for all 22 players" advertised. NO pricing published anywhere on the page; the only route is "Get in touch today". statsperform.com/opta-api/ returns 404.
candidates.eliminated_because: sales-gated with no published price, and enterprise event/tracking feeds for four leagues are four-figures-per-season territory. Backlog S-8 already ruled this out on value: a measured xG effect of +0.0235, not significant at n=162, cannot justify it. Included here for completeness, not as a live option.

candidates.name: StatsBomb / Hudl (commercial)
candidates.evidence: "190+ competitions"; delivery via "Easy-to-use APIs" and JSON/XML/CSV; no league list; no pricing; "Fill out this form to get in touch with our sales team."
candidates.eliminated_because: same as Opta - sales-gated, no price, value not justified by the measured effect size. The FREE open data is archived separately and is a training corpus, not a feed.

candidates.name: Wyscout (Hudl)
candidates.evidence: same corporate parent as StatsBomb; API access is enterprise and sales-gated.
candidates.eliminated_because: no published API pricing; scouting-platform product, not a fixture-stats feed for automated ingestion.

candidates.name: Sportradar
candidates.evidence: developer portal is public; pricing is not. Third-party comparison reports "starting costs at $500 to $1,000 or more per month".
candidates.eliminated_because: an order of magnitude more than the shortlist for data whose incremental value here is a non-significant +0.02.

candidates.name: SportsDataIO
candidates.evidence: names MLS, Premier League, La Liga and Liga MX explicitly; "Scores - Stats - Odds - Projections - News - Images". xG is NOT mentioned anywhere on the page. No published pricing; free trial gives "last season's data" per third-party comparison; Discovery Lab reported at $99-$149/mo.
candidates.eliminated_because: criterion 3 - no evidence of xG, which is the only reason to buy. Would be a fixture-stats duplicate of what ESPN already gives free.

candidates.name: SofaScore (and RapidAPI wrappers derived from it)
candidates.evidence: the internal API and the terms page both refuse non-browser clients.
candidates.eliminated_because: undocumented internal endpoint behind bot protection, with no public terms readable to check. Identical class to the ligamx.net /ws/<base64> RPC and to Understat/FBref, all already rejected under this project's no-contract-less-scraping rule. Resellers of SofaScore-shaped data inherit the same defect.

candidates.name: TheStatsAPI (thestatsapi.com)
candidates.probe: GET https://api.thestatsapi.com/api/health -> 200 {"status":"healthy"}; GET https://api.thestatsapi.com/api/football/competitions -> 401 UNAUTHORIZED; docs and llms.txt -> 200
candidates.evidence: genuinely good API SHAPE for this use: documented /matches/{id}/shotmap "every shot in a match with xG, coordinates, body part, situation ... and non-penalty xG summary"; /matches/{id}/stats grouped "overview, shots, attack, passes, duels, defending, goalkeeping, and xG"; stable string ids (comp_3039, mt_838955483); and per-competition availability booleans has_team_stats, has_player_stats, xg_available, odds_available. Claims "150 competitions by default ... up to 1,196 on request", "10 years of historical data", pricing $50 / $129 / $379 per month with a 7-day trial.
candidates.eliminated_because: THREE unresolved problems, none of them fatal on its own: (a) the docs name no leagues at all, so MLS/Liga MX coverage and xg_available for them is entirely unverified; (b) DATA PROVENANCE IS UNSTATED - the entity model (shotmap with body part and situation, player heatmaps, player ratings) is shaped exactly like SofaScore's, and a provider that will not say where its xG comes from cannot satisfy criterion 5 for a project that rejected scraping on principle; (c) $50/mo minimum is above the shortlist for less evidence. Worth a second look only if the recommendation fails its probe - ask them in writing who supplies the xG model.

candidates.name: Highlightly
candidates.evidence: claims "950+ leagues in 170+ countries" naming MLS; free tier 100 req/day; $9.49-$45.99/mo. xG not mentioned.
candidates.eliminated_because: criterion 3 - no xG claim; and Liga MX not named.

candidates.name: TheSportsDB
candidates.probe: GET https://www.thesportsdb.com/api/v1/json/3/search_all_leagues.php?c=Mexico&s=Soccer -> 200 with real league metadata using the documented public test key
candidates.evidence: openly reachable, returns league/season metadata; carries idAPIfootball cross-reference ids, which is a genuinely useful identity-bridging artefact.
candidates.eliminated_because: metadata and results, not per-fixture team stats, no per-player match stats, no xG.

candidates.name: apifootball.com (APIFootball / Elenasport - a DIFFERENT vendor from api-football.com)
candidates.evidence: key-gated; note the API returns HTTP 200 while reporting an error 404 in the body - a provider that lies in its status line.
candidates.eliminated_because: no xG claim found; and an API that returns 200 on auth failure is a fail-open ingestion hazard for a platform whose whole discipline is that missing evidence must never read as success.

candidates.name: Sportec Solutions (the actual source of the MLS xG this platform already uses)
candidates.evidence: stats-api.mlssoccer.com is a public no-auth reflection of Sportec data for MLS; Sportec (a DFL subsidiary) supplies MLS and the Bundesliga.
candidates.eliminated_because: wrong league set - no EPL, La Liga or Liga MX. Nothing to buy that would widen coverage.

candidates.name: Understat, FBref/StatsBomb-via-scrape, FotMob, ligamx.net internal RPC, apim.laliga.com
candidates.evidence: previously settled in this repo: apim.laliga.com answers 401 subscription-required, ligamx.net serves an obfuscated /ws/<base64> RPC, and Understat/FBref are contract-less scrapes.
candidates.eliminated_because: DECISION ALREADY MADE. Not reopened, not re-probed, and not proposed.
